description: This file defines an Angular service called ApiService that provides methods to interact with backend APIs for users, customers, billing categories, hours, dashboard metrics, and reports. It uses Angular's dependency injection and HttpClient to perform HTTP requests.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Centralized service class for making API calls to the backend. Includes methods to list, create, update, and delete entities like users, customers, categories, hours, dashboard statistics, and reports.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users by sending a GET request to /api/users.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user by sending a POST request to /api/users with the user data.

methods.name: listCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers via GET /api/customers.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer via POST /api/customers with customer data.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by ID via DELETE /api/customers/{id}.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Lists all billing categories via GET /api/categories.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new billing category via POST /api/categories.

methods.name: updateCategoryRate
methods.description: Updates the hourly rate for a billing category via PATCH /api/categories/{id}/rate.

methods.name: listRecentHours
methods.description: Retrieves recent billable hours, default limit 20, via GET /api/hours.

methods.name: logBillableHour
methods.description: Logs a new billable hour entry via POST /api/hours.

methods.name: getDashboardSummary
methods.description: Fetches dashboard metrics including total customers, users, and revenue via GET /api/dashboard.

methods.name: getCustomerBillReport
methods.description: Generates a customer billing report with line items via GET /api/reports/customer/{customerId}.

methods.name: getMonthlyReport
methods.description: Generates a monthly report for specified year and month via GET /api/reports/monthly.

methods.name: getRevenueSummary
methods.description: Retrieves revenue summaries per customer and category via GET /api/reports/revenue.

ctags.name: params
ctags.pattern: /^    const params = new HttpParams().set('year', year.toString()).set('month', month.toString());$/
